title: Build for What Comes Next: The 2026 Virtual Launch
title_zh: 面向未来的造物 · 2026 线上发布会全片
summary: A flight from Donna’s desk crosses Singapore’s Tide Arena and enters the independent observatory of The Omega Institute. Inspect a Fredkin counterexample in Lean, watch a NyxID credential go from HTTP 200 to 401, and follow nine AI roles through a launch rehearsal before returning to Marina Bay.
summary_zh: 镜头从 Donna 的前台穿过新加坡潮汐剧场，飞入独立科研机构 The Omega Institute 的观测站。在 Lean 内核中核对 Fredkin 反例，看 NyxID 吊销凭据后响应从 HTTP 200 变为 401，再跟随九个 AI 岗位走过彩排，回到滨海湾。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: Forward-only 30 fps 3D flights and live product captures, phrase-timed glass telemetry, bilingual cinema subtitles and a split-screen Marina Bay / spiral galaxy coda.
